item.title: Access to storage
item.description:
See also Understanding JASMIN storage which explains more about the different types of storage.

Home directory  

Every JASMIN user is allocated a HOME directory located at /home/users/<username>. This directory is available across most of the interactive and batch computing resources, including the JASMIN login and transfer servers.

item.title: Understanding JASMIN storage
item.description:
Introduction  

JASMIN continues to grow as a unique collaborative analysis environment for an expanding community of scientists. We continue to face big challenges with the ever-growing demand for storage space and the increasing diversity of scientific workflows.
